capabilities: Run LLM agents in an MCP-style tool loop against the vault
Execute local shell commands with human-in-the-loop authorization
Manage multiple agent profiles with custom system prompts and API endpoints
Render HTML files from the vault and inject interactive dashboard widgets into Markdown
Set per-profile model context limits to control token usage
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README warns to enable SYS_EXEC BYPASS only in trusted local environments, since the plugin can run shell commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run local LLM agents that can take actions in the vault, run shell commands, or inject live UI into notes.

requires.name: API endpoint for the agent profile

summary: Agentic shell that runs local LLM agents in a tool loop to execute shell commands, manage profiles, and render HTML dashboards in notes.
